prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-game skill materials for Kagami, a moonlit mirror priestess support.
Create TWELVE clearly separated original effects in a strict FOUR columns by THREE rows grid. Equal cells, generous transparent margins, no labels, letters, gridlines, characters or backgrounds.
Simple chunky game pixels, crisp dark navy outlines and restrained flat shades. Palette: pale silver, lavender, ivory and muted violet; readable on light and dark terrain. No realistic glass render, glossy blur, gradients or giant explosions.
Row 1: (1) a small pointed silver mirror shard travelling right, with a short lavender streak; (2) compact shard-hit sparkle and angular glass fragments; (3) a horizontal braided lavender mirror thread with a clear silver node at each end; (4) swap arrival burst, a broken circular mirror rim with an empty centre.
Row 2: (1) top-down circular mirror-rune stun ring with angular silver shards around its circumference, flat on the ground; (2) clone appearance, a narrow vertical broken-mirror doorway with translucent wisps; (3) healing motif, three ivory rising petals inside a lavender crescent; (4) compact Kindred Charm star-knot with three small diamond sparkles.
Row 3: (1) Guardian Angel protective silver wings flaring outward above a flat circular pressure ring; (2) tall faceted cracked-mirror seal cocoon, a transparent lavender shell with empty interior so the sealed location stays readable; (3) revive shell shattering outward in calm upward mirror shards; (4) a restrained vertical mirror-glass shimmer aura with empty centre to fit around a human sprite.
Keep the seal, protective wings, healing and swap effects visually distinct. Ground rings are top-down circles, not upright wheels. True transparent background, no black rectangular cells, no full-screen flash, no blood. This is a production source sheet for extraction to small pixel assets, not a poster.
